definitions.explanation: The act of paying for something, especially at a restaurant or store.
The management or recording of financial transactions.

examples.japanese: お{会計|かいけい}をお{願|ねが}いします。
examples.english: Check, please. / May I have the bill?

examples.japanese: {会計|かいけい}はレジでお{願|ねが}いします。
{彼女|かのじょ}は{会計|かいけい}{事務所|じむしょ}で{働|はたら}いている。
examples.english: She works at an accounting firm.

notes:
{会計|かいけい} has two main meanings: payment (at a store/restaurant) and accounting (as a profession/field).

COMMON PATTERNS:
- お{会計|かいけい}をお{願|ねが}いします (Check, please)
- {会計|かいけい}を{済|す}ませる (to pay the bill)
- {別|べつ}{会計|かいけい}で (separate checks)
- {会計|かいけい}{士|し} (certified public accountant)
- {会計|かいけい}{年度|ねんど} (fiscal year)

USAGE NOTE:
- In restaurants, お{会計|かいけい} is polite; you can also just say {勘定|かんじょう}お{願|ねが}いします
- Signs at stores often say {会計|かいけい} or レジ for the checkout area
